_note: Curated by hand from the commit history. Each entry names the commit it stands on so the claim can be checked.

milestones.title: Design docs before a line of code
milestones.body: The brief, layout, flows, architecture spec and decision log land first. The app is designed on paper for an hour before the scaffold exists.

milestones.title: A running board ninety minutes after the scaffold
milestones.body: Seeded fleet, pure HOS math with tests, rules as data, the three-pane shell, Lookout, the route file — and the generated fleet moving against the clock.

milestones.title: A second tool signs the log
milestones.body: Codex takes its first design pass across the board, cards, route rail and Lookout. From here the build is two tools working the same tree.

milestones.title: The map ships
milestones.body: A map view on the route file with the truck as a live fix — the Phase 2 feature the brief said never to put on the critical path, kept behind a toggle.

milestones.title: Board and Map become one control
milestones.body: One segmented switch, and a route file that remembers where it was opened from. The product stops being two pages and becomes one workspace.

milestones.title: Live on Vercel
milestones.body: Deployed with the Vite preset, the live link in the README. From this commit on, every change is public within a minute.

milestones.title: The project file
milestones.body: Lena's avatar opens a settings page that walks Project, Lena, Problems, Solutions, Why — the case for the work, made inside the work.

milestones.title: Lookout explains itself
milestones.body: Its pick chip opens a dialog on how it orders the shift. The co-pilot's last feature is accountability for its own ranking.
